findings.description: The `already_bracketed` guard was removed from `make_metavar`, so an optional argument whose type metavar is already bracketed now gets bracketed a second time.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an optional Argument (required=False) whose type's get_metavar returns a bracketed string, e.g. a custom ParamType or Choice-like metavar such as "[a|b]". The old code skipped wrapping when the metavar was already bracketed. The new code always wraps it, so usage text shows "[[a|b]]". Users see malformed help and usage output. Because the check was deliberately present, this is likely an unintended regression.
